title: Pumpkin Mafroum with Lentils and Mushrooms
subtitle: pumpkin slices sandwiched with a hearty filling
description: Slices of pumpkin pressed together around a filling of black lentils, portobello mushrooms and zucchini, braised and then finished in the oven until lightly browned.

steps.text: Soak the black lentils for 8 hours in plenty of water and drain. Cut the pumpkin into 1 cm thick wedges.

Fry the chopped onions in 3 tbsp olive oil in a wide pot over medium heat for about 10 minutes until golden, stirring occasionally. Add the chopped portobello mushrooms and fry for about 20 minutes until softened and browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic and lentils, stir and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the finely grated zucchini, salt, pepper and baharat.
Blitz half the filling in a food processor with 2 to 3 pulses, return to the rest of the filling and mix.
Place a spoonful of filling between two pumpkin slices and press together. Repeat until the filling is used up.

Lay the stuffed slices in a wide, flat ovenproof pot. Pour over the olive oil and 1 cup water, sprinkle with salt, pepper and za'atar leaves, cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. After 15 minutes, preheat the oven to 170°C. When the 30 minutes are up, transfer the covered pot to the oven and bake for about 40 minutes. Switch to grill mode, remove the lid and cook for another 20 minutes to brown lightly.
